name: guidalia
description: Look up places, self-guided audio itineraries, local guides and guided tours from the Guidalia catalogue.

interface.longDescription:
Guidalia connects ChatGPT to the Guidalia catalogue of places, self-guided audio itineraries, local guides and guided tours.

With Guidalia you can:
- Find sights, monuments, museums and other places around a city, from open data, with links to Wikipedia where they exist.
- See the self-guided audio itineraries and guided tours near a place.
- Search self-guided audio itineraries around a city and read their ordered stops.
- Search guided tours led by local guides, optionally in a language the guide speaks.
- Read a guide's public profile: languages, specialties, review excerpts and tours.
- Check the open start times of a guided tour, or of a guide for a private booking, up to 14 days at a time.

Every answer links to the matching page on guidalia.com, where the place, itinerary, tour or guide opens in the Guidalia app or on the web.

Guidalia is read-only. It never books, pays or reserves anything, and it needs no account or sign-in. Content is available in 13 languages; when a text is not available in the requested language, the original or English version is returned.

Privacy: Guidalia receives only the arguments of each request, such as a city name or search words. It does not receive your conversation or your identity, it never records the search text, and it uses the caller's IP address only in memory to apply rate limits.
defaultPrompt: Show me self-guided audio itineraries in Florence.
What sights and monuments can I visit in Rome?
Find a local guide in Florence who speaks Spanish.

positive.description: Find self-guided itineraries in a city
positive.prompt: Show me self-guided audio itineraries in Florence.
positive.expected_behavior: List several self-guided audio itineraries in Florence with stop count, duration, walking distance, languages and a guidalia.com link for each.

positive.description: Read the stops of an itinerary
positive.prompt: Show me the stops of the itinerary The monumental heart of the Duomo in Florence.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the itinerary and list its 4 ordered stops (Santa Maria del Fiore, Giotto's Campanile, Museum of Bigallo, Baptistery) with short descriptions and the itinerary link.

positive.prompt: What sights and monuments can I visit in Rome?
positive.expected_behavior: List places in Rome such as archaeological sites, churches and landmarks, with Wikipedia links where available and a guidalia.com link for each.

positive.prompt: Which museums are there in Rome?
positive.expected_behavior: List museums in Rome (category museum), each with a guidalia.com link, without inventing opening hours or prices.

positive.description: Find and read a local guide's profile
positive.prompt: Find a local guide in Florence who speaks Spanish and tell me about them.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the Florence guide Sara Gazzeri, with her spoken languages (including Spanish), specialties, bio and profile link.

negative.description: Booking and payment are not supported
negative.prompt: Book a tour with a guide in Florence for tomorrow at 10 and pay with my card.
What will the weather be in Florence tomorrow?
Cancel my Guidalia booking and refund me.

review.commerce_description: Guidalia does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. It is read-only and only links to guidalia.com pages.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search places, self-guided audio itineraries, guided tours and local guides, and check open start times.

it-IT.subtitle: Luoghi, tour e guide locali
it-IT.description: Guidalia collega ChatGPT al catalogo Guidalia di luoghi, itinerari audio autoguidati, guide locali e visite guidate. Puoi cercare luoghi, monumenti e musei in una città, itinerari autoguidati con le loro tappe, visite guidate e profili pubblici delle guide, e vedere gli orari di inizio disponibili. Ogni risposta rimanda alla pagina corrispondente su guidalia.com. Guidalia è di sola lettura: non prenota, non paga e non modifica nulla, e non richiede account.
